mapper.sql: SELECT WL.*, E.ENAME, D.DNAME, E.JOB, ME.ENAME AS MGR_ENAME FROM WORK_LOG WL LEFT JOIN EMP E ON WL.EMPNO = E.EMPNO LEFT JOIN DEPT D ON E.DEPTNO = D.DEPTNO LEFT JOIN EMP ME ON WL.MGR_EMPNO = ME.EMPNO
mapper.select: WHERE WL.EMPNO = #{empno} ORDER BY WL.LOG_DATE DESC, WL.CREATED_AT DESC
WHERE WL.MGR_EMPNO = #{mgrEmpno} ORDER BY WL.LOG_DATE DESC, WL.CREATED_AT DESC
WHERE WL.STATUS = 'MGR_APPROVED' ORDER BY WL.MGR_AT ASC
ORDER BY WL.LOG_DATE DESC, WL.CREATED_AT DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO WORK_LOG (LOG_ID, EMPNO, LOG_DATE, TITLE, CONTENT, STATUS, MGR_EMPNO, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (#{logId}, #{empno}, #{logDate}, #{title}, #{content}, #{status}, #{mgrEmpno}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE)
mapper.update: UPDATE WORK_LOG SET LOG_DATE = #{logDate}, TITLE = #{title}, CONTENT = #{content}, STATUS = #{status}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE LOG_ID = #{logId} AND EMPNO = #{empno}

UPDATE WORK_LOG SET STATUS = #{status}, REJECT_REASON = #{rejectReason}, REJECTED_BY = #{rejectedBy}, MGR_COMMENT = CASE WHEN #{mgrComment} IS NOT NULL THEN #{mgrComment} ELSE MGR_COMMENT END, ADMIN_COMMENT = CASE WHEN #{adminComment} IS NOT NULL THEN #{adminComment} ELSE ADMIN_COMMENT END, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE LOG_ID = #{logId}
UPDATE WORK_LOG SET MGR_AT = SYSDATE WHERE LOG_ID = #{logId}
UPDATE WORK_LOG SET ADMIN_AT = SYSDATE WHERE LOG_ID = #{logId}
